## 🔍 Overview

WISE AI is a web-based deepfake detection system that leverages state-of-the-art AI models through the Hugging Face Inference API. It provides real-time analysis of digital media to detect AI-generated or manipulated content, helping users verify the authenticity of images, videos, and audio files.

---

## ✨ Features

| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ **Image Detection** | Analyzes images for AI manipulation with high accuracy |
| 🎥 **Video Detection** | Frame-by-frame deepfake analysis for video content |
| 🎵 **Audio Detection** | Detects synthetic voices and AI-generated speech |
| 🎨 **Modern Interface** | User-friendly UI with drag & drop support |
| ⚡ **Real-time Results** | Instant analysis powered by Hugging Face API |
| 🎯 **High Accuracy** | Enhanced scoring algorithm with multiple detection indicators |

---

## 🛠️ Tech Stack

- **Frontend**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **API**: [Hugging Face Inference API](https://huggingface.co/inference-api)
- **UI Framework**: Custom CSS with Font Awesome Icons
- **File Handling**: HTML5 File API
- **Models Used**:
  - Image/Video: `facebook/detr-resnet-50`
  - Audio: `facebook/wav2vec2-base`

## 🚀 Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- A modern web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
- A [Hugging Face account](https://huggingface.co/join) with an API token
- A local web server or simply open the HTML file directly

### Installation

**1. Clone the repository**
```bash
git clone https://github.com/ibrahimrasyid/WISE-AI.git
cd WISE-AI
```

**2. Get your Hugging Face API Token**

- Go to [huggingface.co/settings/tokens](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens)
- Click **"New token"**
- Give it a name (e.g., `WISE-AI`) and set role to **"Read"**
- Click **"Generate a token"** and copy it

**3. Configure your API Token**

Open `js/deepware.js` and find this line:

```javascript
const API_TOKEN = 'your_huggingface_token_here';
```

Replace `your_huggingface_token_here` with your actual token:

```javascript
const API_TOKEN = 'hf_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx';
```

> ⚠️ **Important**: Never commit your real token to Git. See the [Security](#-security) section below.

**4. Run the application**

Simply open `deepware-api.html` in your browser:
```bash
# On Windows
start deepware-api.html

# On Mac
open deepware-api.html

# Or use a local server (recommended)
npx serve .
```

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

### Using Environment Variables (Recommended)

For better security, store your token in an `.env` file instead of hardcoding it.

**1. Copy the example file**
```bash
cp .env.example .env
```

**2. Edit `.env` and fill in your token**
```env
HF_API_TOKEN=hf_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

**3. Make sure `.env` is in your `.gitignore`**
```
.env
```

> ✅ The `.gitignore` in this repo already includes `.env` by default.

---

## 📖 Usage

1. Open `deepware-api.html` in your browser
2. Upload a file using drag & drop or the file picker
3. Click **"Analyze Content"**
4. Wait for the API to process your file
5. Review the detailed detection results

---

## 📂 Supported Formats

| Media Type | Supported Formats |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ **Image** | JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP |
| 🎥 **Video** | MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM |
| 🎵 **Audio** | MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC |

> Maximum file size: **100MB**

---

## 📊 Analysis Results

After analysis, the system provides:

- **Authenticity Score** — Content authenticity score (0–100%) using an enhanced multi-indicator algorithm
- **Manipulation Risk** — Risk level of manipulation: `Low` / `Medium` / `High`
- **Confidence Level** — Analysis confidence: `Low` / `Medium` / `High` / `Very High`
- **Detailed Analysis** — Per-category breakdown with artifact and pattern detection
- **Recommendations** — Actionable insights based on detection results

---

## 🔧 Troubleshooting

### ❌ Error: "API request failed"
- Check your internet connection
- Make sure your Hugging Face token is valid and has not expired
- Verify the token is correctly pasted in `deepware.js`
- Ensure you have access to the model endpoints on Hugging Face

### ❌ File not detected / not processing
- Make sure the file format is supported (see [Supported Formats](#-supported-formats))
- Check that the file size is under 100MB
- Try refreshing the page and re-uploading the file

### ❌ Token-related errors
- Regenerate your token at [huggingface.co/settings/tokens](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens)
- Make sure the token role is set to **"Read"** or higher

---

## 🔒 Security

- ✅ Files are uploaded directly to the Hugging Face API — no server-side storage
- ✅ Token is stored client-side (suitable for demo/educational purposes)
- ⚠️ For production deployment, **never expose your API token** in client-side code
- ⚠️ Always add `.env` to `.gitignore` to prevent accidental token leaks
- ⚠️ If your token is accidentally pushed to GitHub, **revoke it immediately** at [huggingface.co/settings/tokens](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens) and generate a new one
